==Description==
'''April Fools 2021''' was the second April Fools edition that was added to the game on the 1st of April 2021, and was removed from the game on the 2nd of April 2021. It added a joke enemy that would give a badge upon being killed. 

==Changes==
Wave 1 of [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode was changed to spawn the newly added enemy, [[Imposter]], at the start of it, one for each entrance of a map. Additionally, the [[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on that wave was also changed to fit the [[Imposter]] spawning.
